chunks: And Ali, peace be upon him, said:
Beware of debt, for it is humiliation during the day, worry at night, accountability in this world, and accountability in the Hereafter.

key_terms.الدَّيْنَ: debt; a financial obligation owed to others
key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: this world; worldly life and its immediate consequences
key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the Hereafter; the final abode where one is held to account
key_terms.قَضَاءٌ: accountability; the settling and due fulfillment of what is owed
key_terms.مَذَلَّةٌ: humiliation; a state of abasement and loss of dignity
key_terms.مَهَمَّةٌ: worry; anxiety and distress that occupies a person

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about debt and its consequences?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام warns against falling into debt because of the burden and disgrace it brings in daily life. The hadith highlights both worldly consequences and ultimate reckoning, showing that financial obligations carry moral and spiritual weight.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3682 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Beware of debt, for it is humiliation during the day, worry at night, accountability in this world, and accountability in the Hereafter."
